page_title: INT 2-0 GEN | Inter v Genoa 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Genoa will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Andy Diouf (Inter) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) for Aaron Martin.
84' The attendance is 72945.
82' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
80' Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.

80' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the right-hand post.
79' Genoa are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
78' Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' Andy Diouf (Inter) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Neat passing move from Genoa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Davide Frattesi (Inter) replaces Piotr Zielinski.
76' It is time for a substitution. Andy Diouf (Inter) is on for Ange-Yoan Bonny.
70' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Justin Bijlow no chance!
70' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Inter.
69' The referee blows his whistle after Amorim (Genoa) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
67' Stefan de Vrij will be replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
66' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Tommaso Baldanzi and he is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Colombo.
65' It must be a yellow card. It is. Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
65' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
62' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
61' The ball possession at the moment is 63:37.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha departs the field of play to be replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
59' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan will be replaced by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Marcus Thuram.
58' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
58' Vitinha (Genoa) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Inter are taking a throw-in.
55' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) brought his opponent down.
54' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Inter have a corner.
50' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
46' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Daniele De Rossi has made a change at the break. Amorim (Genoa) has come on in place of Ruslan Malinovskyi.
46' Referee Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Genoa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' 5:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
40' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Justin Bijlow comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Marcus Thuram (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is able to continue to play.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Federico Dimarco (Inter) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
30' Marcus Thuram (Inter) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Justin Bijlow is prepared and dives to thwart him.
27' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Crossbar! Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
25' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
21' 71:29 – the ratio of ball possession.
21' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
20' A pass by Leo Ostigard (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Justin Bijlow (Genoa).

17' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Justin Bijlow. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Piotr Zielinski (Inter).

13' Manuel Akanji (Inter) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
13' The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
12' None of the Genoa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
9' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
8' The game is interrupted as Luis Henrique (Inter) is flagged offside.

7' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
7' Manuel Akanji (Inter) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Leo Ostigard (Genoa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
5' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.

Inter will kick-off.
